build.title: What can I build for you?
build.subline: I'm not limited to a list of services. If your idea needs a system on the web, we sit together and turn it into a clear plan.

cards.text: warehouses, sales, staff and reports: one system instead of paper, Excel and scattered files.
learning platforms, marketplaces and apps your customers or staff use every day.
Tell me about it. We start with a session to understand what you need, then I suggest the solution, the price and the delivery date.

process.title: How we work together
process.subline: Clear steps, from the first meeting to after launch.

steps.text: a first meeting to understand your idea and what you really need, with ideas from past work.
we agree in writing on what will be built, the price and the delivery date.
you follow the progress every week and see the system take shape step by step.
I hand over a working system, with 2 free months for fixes and small additions, then optional monthly maintenance.

process.closing: We don't part ways at delivery.

about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm Ibrahim Fares, a web systems developer from Egypt. Since 2022 I've worked on real systems that companies, schools and restaurants in Egypt and the Gulf use every day. For founders and startups, I build the whole system, frontend and backend. With product teams, I work remotely as a frontend developer. I like everything clear and organised: what we'll build, when, and how we'll track progress.
